pack.name: HIPAA / HITECH Safeguards
pack.description: PHI handling, audit, and encryption themes for healthcare architectures. Not HIPAA certification.

rules.title: PHI system boundary documented
rules.description: Architecture must delineate which components create, receive, maintain, or transmit ePHI — not treat PHI scope as implicit.
rules.remediationGuidance: Mark PHI-scoped services and datastores in governance.ComplianceTags and datastores[].Tags; state boundary in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Risk analysis themes documented for PHI workloads
rules.description: Manifest should reference periodic risk analysis covering threats to confidentiality, integrity, and availability of ePHI.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document risk-analysis cadence in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Assigned security responsibility identified
rules.description: A named security official or team accountable for HIPAA safeguard implementation must be referenced at system scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record security responsibility in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Workforce security and authorization
rules.description: Role-based workforce access to ePHI systems must document authorization procedures and termination handling.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe workforce access procedures in governance.RequiredControls; align identity roles with services[].Tags.

rules.title: Information access management
rules.description: Access to ePHI must follow minimum necessary principles with documented approval workflows for new privileges.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture minimum-necessary policy in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Security awareness and training themes
rules.description: Architecture integrations affecting PHI (new portals, APIs) should reference workforce training and phishing awareness programs.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note training program hooks in governance.ComplianceTags when user-facing PHI systems are in scope.

rules.title: Security incident procedures documented
rules.description: PHI breach detection, containment, and notification workflows must be identifiable from architecture monitoring and IR integrations.
rules.remediationGuidance: List IR and breach-notification integration points in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Contingency plan and data backup
rules.description: ePHI systems must document backup, disaster recovery, and emergency mode operations with tested restore procedures.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document RTO/RPO and backup encryption in governance.RequiredControls and datastores[].Tags.

rules.title: Periodic evaluation of safeguards
rules.description: Architecture should reference periodic technical and non-technical evaluations of HIPAA controls — not one-time design only.
rules.remediationGuidance: Add evaluation cadence tags to governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Business associate agreements for subprocessors
rules.description: Third-party services handling ePHI must be enumerated with BAA status and data-flow documentation.
rules.remediationGuidance: List subprocessors on external WritesTo edges; tag BAA status in governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Facility access controls (cloud reliance documented)
rules.description: While physical access is provider-operated, architecture must document reliance on certified data centers and customer access constraints.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note facility/certification reliance in governance.ComplianceTags for region and hosting decisions.

rules.title: Workstation and endpoint security themes
rules.description: Administrative access paths to PHI systems (jump boxes, privileged workstations) must document hardening expectations.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe admin access paths in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Device and media controls for PHI export
rules.description: Data export, backup media, and removable storage paths must document encryption and disposal procedures.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag export and backup flows on relationships[]; document media controls in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Unique user identification
rules.description: No shared accounts for workforce access to ePHI — each user must map to a unique identity for audit attribution.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document unique identity requirement in governance.PolicyConstraints; prohibit shared-account tags on services[].Tags.

rules.title: Emergency access procedure documented
rules.description: Break-glass access to ePHI during emergencies must be time-bound, logged, and reviewed — not standing shared passwords.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record emergency access procedure in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Automatic logoff or session timeout
rules.description: Interactive sessions to PHI applications must document idle timeout or re-authentication for unattended workstations.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture session timeout policy in governance.PolicyConstraints and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Encryption and decryption of ePHI
rules.description: ePHI at rest and in transit must document encryption mechanisms meeting organizational standards — addressable implementation required.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record encryption controls in governance.RequiredControls and datastores[].Tags; cite Azure SSE/TDE from extractor.

rules.title: Audit controls and PHI access logging
rules.description: Systems touching ePHI must produce audit trails for access, modification, and disclosure with tamper-resistant storage.
rules.remediationGuidance: List audit log destinations in governance.RequiredControls; align with azureExtractor diagnostic settings.

rules.title: Integrity controls for ePHI
rules.description: Architecture must document controls preventing unauthorized alteration or destruction of ePHI (checksums, WORM, versioning).
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe integrity mechanisms in governance.PolicyConstraints and datastores[].Tags.

rules.title: Mechanism to authenticate ePHI
rules.description: Where integrity risk is high, document how ePHI authenticity is verified (digital signatures, HMAC, immutable logs).
rules.remediationGuidance: Note authentication-of-data mechanisms in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Person or entity authentication
rules.description: All PHI system access must document strong authentication (MFA, federated SSO) appropriate to risk.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag authentication requirements on services[].Tags; document MFA in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Transmission security for ePHI
rules.description: Electronic transmission of ePHI must use TLS or equivalent with documented exceptions and compensating controls.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document TLS minimums in governance.PolicyConstraints; map PHI flows on relationships[].relationshipType.

rules.title: Integrity controls in transit
rules.description: End-to-end integrity for PHI transmissions (mTLS, signed payloads) should be documented for high-risk integrations.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe in-transit integrity in governance.RequiredControls for partner API and HL7/FHIR edges.

rules.title: Encryption in transit for ePHI
rules.description: All internet and cross-zone PHI paths must assume encryption in transit unless documented isolated network exception.
rules.remediationGuidance: Align HTTPS-only assumptions with relationships[]; record exceptions in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Minimum necessary access for APIs exposing PHI
rules.description: APIs returning PHI must document field filtering, scope limits, and purpose-bound tokens — not full-record dumps by default.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document API scoping in services[].Purpose and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: De-identification and limited data set themes
rules.description: Analytics or secondary-use paths must document de-identification method or limited data set agreements before PHI reuse.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag analytics datastores with de-id method in datastores[].Tags and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Patient access and amendment integration hooks
rules.description: Systems of record for PHI should reference how individual access and amendment requests are supported operationally.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note patient-rights operational hooks in metadata.ChangeDescription when EHR or patient portal services are in scope.

rules.title: Breach notification workflow alignment
rules.description: Architecture monitoring must support breach risk assessment timelines — detection sources and escalation paths documented.
rules.remediationGuidance: List breach-assessment triggers in governance.RequiredControls and security monitoring services[].Tags.
